रंह्: 1. रंह् रंह् (akin to लङ्घ्, q. cf.), i. 1, Par. and † i. 10, Par. To go, to move, with speed. Caus. To impel to speed, Chr. 291, 5 = Rigv. i. 85, 5. --Cf. perhaps τρέχω; Goth. thragjan; in this case the Sskr. word has dropped the initial.
2. † रंह् रंह्, वंह् वंह्, i. 10, Par. To speak, to shine.
रंहस्: रंहस् 1. रंह् + अस्, n. Speed, velo-city, Ragh. 2, 34 (Calc.).  -- Comp. अति-, adj. of excessive velocity, Śāk. d. 5. वात-, adj. swift as the wind, Indr. 1, 7.
रक्: † रक् {†रक्,} लक् लक्, रग् रग्, लग् लग्, रघ् रघ्, i. 10, Par.  1. To taste.  2. To obtain.
रक्क: रक्क रक्क, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 423.
रक्तक: रक्तक रक्त + क (see रङ्ज्), m.  1. Red garments, or cloth.  2. A man affected with fondness or passion.  3. A player.  4. The name of several plants.
रक्तप: रक्तप रक्त-प (1. पा, cf. रञ्ज्।),  I. adj. Who or what drinks blood.  II. m. A Rākṣasa, or demon.  III. f. पा।  1. A leech.  2. A female fiend.
रक्तपायिन्: रक्तपायिन् रक्त-पायिन् (vb. रङ्ज्।),  I. m. A bug.  II. f. नी, A leech.
रक्तफेनज: रक्तफेनज रक्त-फेन-ज, m. A part of the body, apparently intending the lungs.
रक्ष्: रक्ष् रक्ष् (perhaps a desider. of रञ्ज्, without reduplication), i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 8836).  1. To preserve, Man. 7, 213; Pañc. i. d. 402 (Ātm.).  2. To spare, Pañc. iii. d. 253.  3. To guard, to keep, Vikr. 18, 6; Hit. i. d. 194, M.M. (with gen. in the sense of a dat.); to protect from (abl.), MBh. 3, 8762.  4. To tend, to keep, Man. 9, 328.  5. To govern, Man. 7, 36. Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. सु-रक्षित, Well guarded, Nal. 3, 10. धर्म -रक्षिता, f. A proper name, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 14. Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. दूरक्ष्य, i. e. दुस्-, adj. Diffi-cult to be guarded, Mṛcch. 65, 17. Caus. To protect, Pañc. 70, 13. -- With the prep. अभि अभि,  1. To assist, Bhag. 1, 10.  2. To defend, to protect, MBh. 4, 161; Pañc. i. d. 395.  3. To guard, MBh. 1, 5616.  4. To command, Bhag. 1, 10. अभिरक्षित, Cultivated, Pañc. i. d. 254. -- With आ आ, comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. दुस्-आ-रक्ष्य + तम, Most difficult to be protected, Rām. 2, 52, 66. -- With परि परि,  1. To preserve, MBh. 1, 6195.  2. To protect, Pañc. 215, 7; MBh. 3, 14366.  3. To restrain, Man. 9. 10.  4. To govern, Man. 7, 142.  5. To keep, Rām. 2, 96, 38.  6. To conceal, MBh. 3, 14717. -- With प्र प्र, To save, Pañc. v. d. 89. -- With सम् सम्,  1. To pro-tect, Man. 7, 135; Pañc. iii. d. 9.  2. To keep off, Rām. 1, 32, 2. -- Cf. pro-bably ἀρκέω, ἀλκτήρ, ἀλαλκτήρ (fre-quent.), ἄλξις, ἀλέξω; Lat. arx; Goth. ga-rehsns.
रक्ष: रक्ष रक्ष् + अ,  I. m. One who guards, Lass. 34, 8.  II. m., and f. क्षा।  1. Preserving, guarding, Pañc. 184, 8; protecting, protection, Pañc. 157, 7.  2. (i. e. रञ्ज् + त, cf. रक्ता, s.v. रञ्ज्), Lac.  III. f. क्षा।  1. Ashes.  2. A sort of bracelet, an amulet, Śāk. 105, 12 (Prakṛ.).  -- Comp. क्षेत्र-, m. a field-guard, Pañc. 248, 12. गो-,  I. m. a cowhered.  II. n. keeping cattle, MBh. 2, 525. चक्र-, m. two men who take care of the wheels of a chariot, MBh. 1, 5467. नगर-, f. government of a town, Mṛcch. 148, 5. पुर-, m. the watchman of a town, Daśak. 26, 1. सेना-, m. a guard, a sentinel.
रक्षक: रक्षक रक्ष् + अक,  I. adj. Who or what protects, who tends, Man. 8, 102.  II. m. A protector, a guardian, Hit. 91, 1, M.M.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. imprudent, Pañc. 129, 5. अङ्ग-, m. a life-guard, Pañc. 156, 22. गो-, adj. keeping cattle, Man. 8, 102. ब्कूमि-, m. a swift horse. शस्य-, m. a watchman over a field of corn, Hit. 81, 15.
रक्षण: रक्षण रक्षण, i. e. रक्ष् + अन, n. Preserving, protecting, Hit. 114, 7; Pañc. iv. d. 29.
रक्षपाल: रक्षपाल रक्ष-पाल, m. One who guards, Pañc. 217, 4; 232, 2; probably it is to be changed to रक्षापाल, cf. रक्षापुरुष, Pañc. 229, 6, the name.
रक्षस्: रक्षस् रक्ष् + अस् (perhaps a kind of euphemism, cf. Εὐμενίδες, denoting the Ἐριννύες), n. A Rākṣasa, or evil spirit, Vikr. 54, 5.
रक्षिक: रक्षिक रक्षिक, i. e. रक्ष + इक (adj. or m.?), A watchman, a police-man, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 18; 199, 24.
रक्षितृ: रक्षितृ रक्ष् + इतृ, m. One who protects, Pañc. i. d. 391; a protector, a guard, Utt. Rāmac. 39, 11.  -- Comp. अ-, m. one who does not protect, Pañc. iii. d. 72.
रक्षिन्: रक्षिन् रक्ष् + इन्, adj., f. इणी,  I. adj. Who or what guards, Vikr. d. 5.  II. m. A policeman, Śāk. p. 73, 1.  -- Comp. नगर-, नगरी-, and पुर-, m. the watchman of a town, a policeman, Mṛcch. 140, 17; MBh. 13, 6216; Kathās. 13, 169. पशु-, m. a herds-man, Man. 8, 238.
रक्ष्ण: रक्ष्ण रक्ष्ण, i. e. रक्ष् + न, m. Protection.
रख्: † रख् रख्, रङ्ख् रङ्ख्, रिख् रिख्, रिङ्ख् रिङ्ख्, i. 1, Par. To go, to move.
रग्: † रग् रग्, i. 1, Par. To suspect; cf. रक्।
रघु: रघु रघु, i. e. रङ्घ् + उ,  I. adj. ved. = लघु।  II. m.  1. The name of a king, Utt. Rāmac. 96, 3.  2. pl., and often in comp. words, His descend-ants, Rām. 3, 49, 57; Megh. 12 (रघु -पति = Rāma).
रघुपत्वन्: रघुपत्वन् रघु-पत् + वन्, adj., f. वरी, Flying swiftly, Chr. 291, 6 = Rigv. i. 85, 6. -- With -पत्वन्, cf. Lat. -piter, in acci-piter = ved. आशु-पत्वन्।
रघुष्यद्: रघुष्यद् रघुष्यद्, i. e. रघु -स्यन्द्, adj. Moving quickly, Chr. 290, 7 = Rigv. i. 64, 7.
रङ्क: रङ्क रङ्क, adj.  1. Niggardly.  2. Slow.  3. Indigent, poor a beggar, Pañc. i. d. 12; 284.  -- Comp. रण-, m. the part of an elephant's face between his tusks.
रङ्कु: रङ्कु रङ्कु, m. A sort of deer, the spotted axis.
रङ्ग्: † रङ्ग् रङ्ग्, रिङ्ग् रिङ्ग्, i. 1, Par. To go, to move.
रङ्ग: रङ्ग रङ्ग, i. e. रञ्ज् + अ,  I. m.  1. Colour, paint.  2. The place where dancing or acting is exhibited, a stage, Śāk. 4, 12; Daśak. in Chr. 190, 10; a place for an assembly, Nal. 5, 3; 8.  3. A field of battle, Pañc. 35, 3.  4. Dancing, acting, Cṛṅgārat. 17.  5. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 353.  II. n. Tin.  -- Comp. केलि-, m. a pleasure-ground, Lass. 87, 16. पूर्व-, m. the prelude to a drama Śiś. 2, 8. राज(न्)-, n. silver. सु-,  I. m. 1. bright colour. 2. the orange.  II. f. गा, crystal.  III. n. 1. red sanders. 2. vermilion.
रङ्गावतारक: रङ्गावतारक रङ्गावतारक, i. e. रङ्ग-अव-तॄ + अक, m. A stage player, Man. 4, 215.
रङ्घ्: रङ्घ् रङ्घ्, i. 1, Ātm. To go, to move swiftly (cf. लङ्घ्), Bhaṭṭ. 14, 15. † i. 10, To speak, to shine.
रच्: रच् रच्, i. 10, रचय, Par.  1. To make mechanically, Megh. 75.  2. To make, Rām. 2, 13, 12; Kathās. 3, 66 (गतागतम्, literally a going and returning, i. e. looking on him and turn-ing away her eye).  3. To arrange, Gīt. 5, 10.  4. To compose, Pañc. 5, 11.  5. To adorn, Megh. 67.  6. To prepare, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.  7. To string, Pañc. iii. d. 235. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रचित, Written. Caus. रचय, To cause to make, Utt. Rāmac. 127, 14 (मम हृदयं तस्नुन्न् अवधानं रच-यति, Causes my heart to fix itself only on him, i. e. fills it with love). -- With the prep. आ आ, आरचित, Put on, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 6. -- With वि वि, विरचित,  1. Contrived, arranged, Pañc. 86, 18; Ragh. 5, 76.  2. Made, Megh. 19.  3. Ornamented.  4. Composed, Megh. 84; written, Pañc. 103, 4. -- Cf. Lat. lo-care; A.S. logian, To place; Lat. locus; A.S. loh.
रचना: रचना रच् + अना, f.  1. Making, work, Lass. 83, 4; Kathās. 26, 283 ( कनक-, f. Being made, built, of gold.)  2. Orderly arrangement.  3. Dressing of the hair.  4. Stringing flowers.  5. Suspending garlands.  6. The arrange-ment of troops, Pañc. 9, 23.  7. Com-position, Rājat. 5, 380; literary com-position.  -- Comp. कूट-, f. a trap, Pañc. ii. d. 86. केश-, f. dressing of the hair, Ṛt. 4, 15. पक्ष-, f. win-ning friends, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 21. पट-, f. art of making cloth, Pañc. 132, 24. वचन-, f. eloquence, Pañc. 68, 5. विहित-दुर्ग-रचन, adj. having ordered the building of a for-tress, Pañc. 148, 7. व्यूह-, f. arrange-ment of troops, Pañc. 9, 22.
रज: रज रज (see रजस्), m.  1. Dust, Hit. i. d. 152, M.M.  2. The pollen of flowers.  3. The menstrual excretion.  4. The quality of passion.  -- Comp. नी-रज, i. e. निस्-, adj. 1. free from dust, MBh. 13, 3822. 2. free from passion, epithet of Śiva, ib. 13, 1261.
रजक: रजक रजक, i. e. रञ्ज् + अक,  I. m.  1. A washerman, Hit. 50, 1.  2. Cloth.  II. f. की।  1. A washerman's wife.  2. A woman in her courses at the third day, Lass. 10, 9.
रजत: रजत रजत (cf. अर्जुन, रञ्ज्, and राज्),  I. adj. White.  II. n.  1. White, the colour.  2. Silver, Kir. 5, 41; Rājat. 5, 482.  3. Gold.  4. Ivory.  5. Blood.  6. A necklace.  7. The name of the mountain Kailāsa.  8. An as-terism.  -- Comp. महा-, n. gold.
रजन: रजन रजन i. e. रञ्ज् + अन, n.  1. Colouring.  2. Safflower.  -- Comp. म-हा-, n. 1. safflower. 2. gold.
रजनि: रजनि and रजनी रजनी̆, i. e. रञ्ज् + अनी̆, f.  1. Night, Pañc. 128, 11; 248, 5 (नी); Śṛṅgārat. 8 (न्ĭ).  2. The indigo plant.  3. Lac.  4. Turmeric.
रजनिकर: रजनिकर and रजनीकर रजनी̆ -कर, m. The moon, Śiś. 9, 38 (नी).
रजनिचर: रजनिचर and रजनीचर रजनी̆ -चर,  I. adj. Wandering at night, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2583 (नी).  II. m.  1. A Rākṣasa, Rām. 3, 53, 61 (नी).  2. A thief.
रजनीकर: रजनीकर रजनीकर, and रजनीचर रजनीचर, see s.v. रजनि°।
रजस्: रजस् रजस्,  I. i. e. रञ्ज् + अस्, n. (the original signification was probably ‘Dimness;’ cf. रजनि and Goth. riquis).  1. Sky, Chr. 289, 7 = Rigv. i. 50, 7.  2. Dust, Man. 11, 110.  3. The pollen of a flower, Vikr. d. 26.  4. The menses, Man. 4, 41.  II. i. e. perhaps ऋज् + अस् (cf. ὄρεξις), n. The quality of passion, Ve-dāntas. in Chr. 207, 8.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. free from dust, Nal. 24, 42. नीरजस्, i. e. निस्-, adj. 1. free from dust, Rām. 2, 87, 21 Gorr., 2. free from passion, Rām. 4, 44, 41. परोरजस्, see s. v. परस्। वि-,  I. adj. free from passion, Chr. 16, 17.  II. f. a woman who has ceased to menstruate. स-, f. a woman during menstruation. -- Cf. Goth. riquis.
रजस्क: ऽरजस्क -रजस् + क, a substitute for रजस् when latter part of comp. adj.; e. g. नीरजस्क, i. e. निस्-, adj.  1. Free from dust, Rām. 4, 44, 86.  2. Free from passion, Prab. 117, 18, v.r. वि-, adj. Free from dust, Ragh. 10, 74.
रजस्तुर्: रजस्तुर् रजस्-तुर्, adj. Running over the sky (?), Chr. 291, 12 = Rigv. i. 64, 12.
रजस्वल: रजस्वल रजस् + वल,  I. m. A buf-falo.  II. f. ला।  1. A woman who has already her courses, Pañc. iii. d. 219.  2. A woman in her courses, Man. 3, 239.
रजिष्ठ: रजिष्ठ रजिष्ठ, रजीयंस् राजीयंस्, see ऋजु।
रज्जु: रज्जु रज्जु (probably for original स्रज्यु; cf. स्रज् and O.H.G. striech, strie, stracchian; A.S. streccan; Lat. stringere), f. (m., Pañc. i. d. 376 erroneously, cf. my translation, n. 385).  1. A rope, Hit. ii. d. 131; a cord, Pañc. 76, 17.  2. A lock of braided hair.  -- Comp. कर्कटक-, f. a rope with a hook resembling the claw of a crab, Daśak. 71, 2. काष्ठ-, f. a rope for tying bundles of sticks, Rām. 1, 4, 20. पाश-, f. fetter, Kathās. 18, 298.
रज्जुमात्रत्व: रज्जुमात्रत्व रज्जु-मात्र + त्व, n. Condition of being only a rope, Ve-dāntas. in Chr. 211, 24.
रज्जुवाल: रज्जुवाल रज्जुवाल, m. A parti-cular bird, Man. 5, 12.
रञ्ज्: रञ्ज् रञ्ज्। † i. 1, रज, and i. 4, रज्य, Par. Ātm.  1. To dye, to colour, Pañc. 132, 24.  2. To be attached (perhaps originally different and akin to स्रज्, see रज्जु, and लग्).  3. † To go (cf. ऋज्). The reflexive pass. takes also the terminations of the Par.  1. To attach one's self to, Pañc. v. d. 8.  2. To glow, Utt. Rāmac. 138, 2. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रक्त।  1. Coloured.  2. Red, Vikr. d. 124; reddened, d. 136.  3. Agitated by passion, Man. 4, 64.  4. Fond, affected with love, Pañc. i. d. 155, 159; at-tached, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 20.  5. Pure.  6. Sporting. Comparat. रक्त + तर, Very attached, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 19. रक्त, m. Red, the colour. n.  1. Blood, Pañc. 60, 25.  2. Vermilion.  3. Minium.  4. Copper.  5. Saffron. f. ता,  1. Lac.  2. The gunjā plant, Abrus precatorius.  3. Bengal madder.  Comp. आ-, adj. 1. reddish, Vikr. 78. 2. red, Pañc. 64, 15. जिव-, n. the blood of the menses, Suśr. 1, 43, 19. सु-, adj. 1. well dyed. 2. deep red. 3. strongly impassioned. Caus.  I. रञ्जय।  1. To colour, Pañc. 132, 24.  2. To illuminate, Vikr. d. 60; MBh. 1, 6772.  3. To cause to be attached, to conciliate, Pañc. 113, 24; Man. 7, 19.  4. † To worship.  II. † रजय, To hunt. -- With the prep. अनु अनु, i. 4,  1. To grow red and fond, Śiś. 9, 7.  2. To be attached, Bhag. 11, 36; Pañc. i. d. 335.  3. To love, Rām. 3, 55, 15.  4. To dally lasciviously with, Man. 3, 173. अनु-रक्त,  1. Fond, attached, Pañc. 32, 9; loving, Vikr. 59, 21; propitious, Hit. 53, 18.  2. Pleased. Caus.  1. To cause to be in love, to inspire with affection, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 22.  2. To con-ciliate, to win, Daśak. 196, 17. -- With अप अप, अपरक्त (rather रक्त with अप), Discoloured, blanched, Śāk. d. 133. -- With अभि अभि, i. 4, To be re-joiced, Rām. 2, 67, 13. Caus. To colour, to illuminate, Rām. 1, 38, 21. -- With उप उप, उपरक्त,  1. Eclipsed, Rām. 1, 55, 9.  2. Afflicted with pain or calamity. m. Rāhu. -- With वि वि, i. 4, To grow discoloured (viz. the hair), and disinclined (viz. the servants), Pañc. i. d. 94.  2. To grow alienated, Mṛcch. 23, 5. विरक्त,  1. Disin-clined, Bhartṛ. 2, 2.  2. Free from worldly passion, Pañc. 33, 16.  3. Impassioned.  Comp. अ-विरक्त, adj. faithful, Hit. iii. d. 87. -- With सम् सम्, i. 4, To grow red, MBh. 1, 6443. संरक्त,  1. Red, MBh. 5, 273.  2. Inflamed.  3. Impassioned. -- With अनुसम् अनु-सम्, अनुसंरक्त, At-tached, loving, with acc., Rām. 1, 17, 16. -- Cf. ῥέζω, ῥέγος, ῥεγεύς, ῥήσσω, ῥῆγος, λέγνον; probably A.S. ge-reg-nian, to colour.
रञ्जक: रञ्जक रञ्ज् + अक,  I. m.  1. A dyer, Man. 4, 216.  2. A stimulus, an in-citer of affection.  II. n. Red sandal.
रञ्जन: रञ्जन रञ्ज् + अन,  I. m. (?), n.  1. Dyeing, colouring, Rājat. 5, 381.  2. Conciliating, befriending, Rājat. 5, 436 (at the end of a comp. adj.).  3. Ex-citing passion, delighting.  II. n. Red sandal.  III. f. नी, The indigo, and several other plants.  -- Comp. लोक-, n. gaining public confidence. स्त्री-, n. pan eaten with the betel-nut.
रट्: रट् रट्, i. 1, Par. To yell, Mricch. 157, 10; to cry, Kathās. 18, 109. 1. 10, Par. † To speak (?). -- With the prep. आ आ, To call to, Śāk. 55, 5 (Prākṛ.).
रठ्: † रठ् रठ्, i. 1, Par. To speak.
रण्: रण् रण् (developed out of रम्-णा, i. e. रम्, ii. 9), i. 4, and i. 1, Par. i. 4,  1. To shout.  2. To rejoice, Chr. 292, 10 = Rigv. i. 85, 10. i. 1, To sound, Śiś. 1, 10. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रणित, Sounding, Lass. 21, 1. n. Sound. † i. 10, रणय, To go. -- With the prep. नि नि, i. 4, To rejoice, Chr. 297, 18 = Rigv. i. 112, 18.
रण: रण रण् + अ,  I. m.  1. Noise.  2. The quill or bow of a lute.  II. m. and n. War, battle, Pañc. 218, 16. Doubled, रण-रण,  1. m. A musquito.  2. n. Anxiety.  -- Comp. प्रिय-, adj. delight-ing in war. महा-, great battle, Chr. 23, 33.
रणरणक: रणरणक रण-रण + क, m.  1. Regret, care, Utt. Rāmac. 25, 11.  2. Desire.
रण्डक: रण्डक रण्डक, m. A barren tree.
रण्डा: रण्डा रण्डा, f.  1. A widow, Pañc. i. d. 437 (as an abusive word, cf. the last).  2. A plant, Salvinia cucullata.
रण्व्: † रण्व् रण्व्, रम्ब् रम्ब्, रिण्व् रिण्व्, रिम्ब् रिम्ब्, i. 1, Par. To go.
रतर्द्धिक: रतर्द्धिक रतर्द्धिक, i. e. रत (vb. रम्), -ऋद्धि + क, n.  1. A day.  2. Bathing for pleasure.  3. The aggregate of eight auspicious objects.

रोधन: रोधन रोधन, i. e. रुध् + अन,  I. adj. That which obstructs.  II. m. The planet Mercury.  III. n.  1. Obstructing.  2. Besieging.
रोधस्: रोधस् रोधस्, i. e. रुध् + अस्, n.  1. A bank, a shore, Vikr. d. 8.  2. The brink of a well, Bhāg. P. 9, 19, 4.  3. The flank, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 29.
रोधिन्: ऽरोधिन् -रोधिन्, i. e. रुध् + इन्, adj. Stopping, Rājat. 5, 346; Śāk. d. 135.
रोध्र: रोध्र रोध्र, i. e.  I. रुध् + र, n.  1. Sin.  2. Offence.  II. Probably akin to रुधिर, m. A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing, Ragh. 2, 29.
रोप: रोप रोप,  I. m. probably रुह्, Caus., + अ, An arrow.  II. i. e. रुप् = लुप् + अ, Confusing.  III. n. A hole.
रोपण: रोपण रोपण, n.  I. i. e. रुह्, Caus., + अन।  1. Planting.  2. Raising.  3. Placing.  4. Cicatrizing.  5. A healing application to sores.  II. i. e. रुप् = लुप् + अन, Confusing.
रोपणाका: रोपणाका रोपणाका, f. A bird, Tur-dus salica, Chr. 289, 12 = Rigv. i. 50, 12.
रोमन्: रोमन् रोमन्, i. e. रुह् + मन्, n. The hair of the body, Pañc. iii. d. 186.  -- Comp. ऊर्ध्व-,  I. adj. one whose hairs are erect, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 28.  II. m. the name of a mountain, ib. 5, 20, 15. काञ्चन-, and सुवर्ण-, adj. having gold-like wool, Rām. 3, 49, 4; (Pañc. 35, 1, i. e. a ram). स्तब्ध- (vb. स्तम्भ्), m. a hog.
रोमन्थ: रोमन्थ रोमन्थ, probably a noun derived from रुज्, and compounded with मन्थ् + अ, m.  1. Ruminating, Śāk. d. 39.  2. Chewing, Rājat. 5, 364. -- Cf. O.H.G. ita-rucjan; A.S. roccettan; Lat. rūmen, ruminare (for rug-men), ructare; ἐρεύγομαι (old frequent.), ἐρυγγάνω, ὀρυγγάνω, etc.
रोमन्थाय: रोमन्थाय रोमन्थाय, a denomin. derived from रोमन्थ with य, Ātm. To ruminate, Pāṇ. iii. 1, 15.
रोमवत्: रोमवन्त् रोमवन्त्, i. e. रोमन् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Hairy, woolly.
रोमवन्त्: रोमवन्त् रोमवन्त्, i. e. रोमन् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Hairy, woolly.
रोमश: रोमश रोमश, i. e. रोमन् + श,  I. adj.  1. Hairy, Man. 3, 7.  2. Woolly.  II. m.  1. A ram.  2. A hog.
रोमाञ्च: रोमाञ्च रोमाञ्च, i. e. रोमन्-अञ्च् + अ, m. Horripilation, considered as a sign of rapture, Pañc. ii. d. 175.
रोमाञ्चित: रोमाञ्चित रोमाञ्चित, i. e. रोमाञ्-च + इत, adj.  1. Affected with hor-ripilation, Utt. Rāmac. 81, 4.  2. En-raptured, Pañc. 128, 21.
रोष: रोष रोष, i. e. रोष् + अ, m. Anger, wrath, Vikr. d. 144; Pañc. 174. 25.  -- Comp. वि-, adj. angry, Draup. 9, 6. स-, adj. angry, Śiś. 9, 83. षम्, adv. angrily, Vikr. 55, 7.
रोषण: रोषण रोषण, i. e. रुष् + अन,  I. adj. Angry.  II. m.  1. Quicksilver.  2. A touchstone.
रोषणता: रोषणता रोषण + ता, f. Wrath, Śāk. d. 93.
रोह: रोह रोह, i. e. रुह् + अ, m.  1. A bud.  2. Mounting, Rājat. 5, 15.
रोहक: रोहक रोहक, i. e. रुह् + अक,  I. adj. Riding, mounted on any vehicle.  II. m. A sort of goblin.
रोहण: रोहण रोहण, i. e. रुह् + अन,  I. m. A mountain, Adam's peak in Ceylon, Pañc. MS. Berol., cf. Wilson in Trans. of the R.A.S. i. 169.  II. n.  1. Grow-ing.  2. Mountaing.  3. Semen virile.
रोहिण: रोहिण रोहिण, i. e. रुह् + इन् + अ,  I. m.  1. The Indian fig-tree.  2. A fragrant grass.  II. n. A part of the forenoon. See रोहित।
रोहित्: रोहित् रोहित्, probably akin to रु-धिर, ह् for ध्,  I. m. The sun.  II. f. The female of the black antelope.
रोहित: रोहित रोहित, akin to रुधिर, ह् for ध्,  I. adj., f. ता and इणी।  1. Red.  2. Coloured, Man. 1, 38.  II. m.  1. Red, the colour.  2. A (kind of) deer, Utt. Rāmac. 117, 4.  3. A fish, Cypri-nas rohita, Man. 5, 16.  III. f. इणी, also रोहिणि रोहिणि।  1. The fourth lunar asterism, Vikr. 38, 12 (णी).  2. The mother of बल-राम।  IV. f. इणी।  1. Lightning.  2. A girl at the commence-ment of the menstruation, Pañc. iii. d. 213.  3. A woman stained with red pigments.  4. Inflammatory affection of the throat.  5. A cow.  6. Yellow myrobalan.  7. Bengal madder.  V. n.  1. Blood.  2. Safflower.  3. The rain-bow appearing in a straight form.
रोहिन्: रोहिन् रोहिन्,  I. रुह् + इन्, m.  1. The Indian fig-tree.  2. The holy fig-tree.  II. (cf. रोकित्।) A stag, Rām. 5, 36, 35 (but perhaps is to be read रोहिन् -मांसम्, i. e. रोहित्-).
रौक्म: रौक्म रौक्म, i. e. रुक्म + अ, adj. Golden, Man. 4, 36.
रौक्ष्य: रौक्ष्य रौक्ष्य, i. e. रू̆क्ष + य, n. Roughness, hardness, Ragh. 5, 58.
रौचनिक: रौचनिक रौचनिक, i. e. रोचना + इक, adj., f. की, Yellowish, Kir. 5, 45 (cf. also Pāṇ. 4, 2, 2 Sch.).
रौच्य: रौच्य रौच्य, m. An ascetic with a staff of Vilva wood.
रौट्: रौट् रौट्, रौड् रौड्, see रोड्।
रौद्र: रौद्र रौद्र, i. e. रुद्र + अ,  I. adj., f. द्री।  1. Relating to Rudra-Śiva, Arj. 3, 50; cf. 10, 42; descended from Rudra, Johns. Sel. 22, 117.  2. Formidable, Pañc. i. d. 116.  3. Irascible.  4. Acute.  II. m. Heat.  III. f. री, The wife of Śiva.  -- Comp. अति-, adj. exceedingly terrible, Pañc. 216, 9. सोम-, the name of a holy text (perhaps Rigv. vi. 74), Man. 11, 254.
रौद्रता: रौद्रता रौद्र + ता, f. Horribleness, Mālat. 77, 7.
रौद्रीभाव: रौद्रीभाव रौद्रीभाव, i. e. रौद्र -भू + अ, m. The character of Śiva, Johns. Sel. 93, 47.
रौप्य: रौप्य रौप्य, i. e. रूप्य + अ,  I. adj.  1. Of silver, Man. 8, 135.  2. Like silver, Rām. 3, 48, 12.  II. n. Silver, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 14.
रौप्यमय: रौप्यमय रौप्य + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of silver, Rājat. 5, 46.
रौम: रौम रौम, and रौमक रौम + क, n. A sort of salt (cf. रुमन्वन्त्).
रौरव: रौरव रौरव,  I. i. e. रुरु + अ, adj., f. वी।  1. Proceeding from the common deer (viz. flesh, etc.), Man. 2, 41; 3, 269; Utt. Rāmac. 105, 11.  2. Un-steady.  II. adj.  1. Formidable.  2. Dishonest.  III. m.  1. The name of a hell, Man. 4, 88.  2. A savage.  -- Comp. महा-, m. the name of a hell, Man. 4, 88.
रौहिण: रौहिण रौहिण (cf. रोहित), n. Sandal wood, MBh. 1, 1381.
रौहिष: रौहिष रौहिष (cf. रोहित्),  I. m. A sort of deer.  II. f. षी।  1. A doe.  2. A creeper.
